reasons: No label raster found for any date.
requirement: Class ids per pixel from a source independent of the input images (field data, an external land-cover map, or manual annotation). Labels made by thresholding NDVI/NDWI or clustering these same pixels are circular: LDA would just recover the rule used to create them, so accuracy would be meaningless.
searched_also: Repository files, data/processed/sentinel2 (only RGB/False_Color/NDVI/NDWI renderings), the Parquet/CSV schema in docs/DATA_ACCESS_GUIDE.md (x, y, lat, lon, date, B02-B08, NDVI, NDWI, empty LST/population/infrastructure: no class column).
